answer_1.quote: Each example in a summarization dataset contains one or several source document(s) and one or several human‑written reference(s). System‑generated summaries are evaluated by comparing them to the references ...

answer_2.quote: We compare our metrics to 15 existing metrics: ROUGE‑1, ROUGE‑2, ROUGE‑L, AutoSum‑mENG, METEOR, BEwT‑E, S3 (pyr), S3 (resp), PyrEval quality, PyrEval comprehensive, BERTScore, BERTScore (idf), MoverScore, QAEval (EM), QAEval (F1).

answer_3.quote: We use the pretrained RoBERTa‑large based NLI model ... to predict whether the SCU ij is entailed by the summary si.

answer_4.quote: We manually label SCUs and collect SCU‑presence labels for summaries generated by 10 systems on Amazon Mechanical Turk ... Human (or manual) evaluation has been considered as the gold standard.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to indicate for each SCU whether it is present in the system summary.
